config_contracts.reference_surface: CurrentStore::newest_config_version = 5 with config_version persisted as journal::hash("Config Version").
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust storage schema contract must preserve schema version 5 before claiming config-store compatibility.
config_contracts.notes: The schema row pins the current C++ config-store version and the runtime migration entrypoint in perform_config_check.

config_contracts.reference_surface: CurrentStore item declarations and defaults:: constants define current config items, default values, flags, arrays, and ram-only items.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust config item catalog must track item identity, default provenance, item flags, arrays, and ram-only status.
config_contracts.notes: Defaults are source-backed by defaults.hpp; credential-bearing defaults are not reproduced in this manifest.

config_contracts.reference_surface: DeprecatedStore preserves old StoreItem identities and requires successors to keep distinct journal::hash values.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust deprecated-item contract must preserve DeprecatedStore identity, hashed IDs, and migration triggers.
config_contracts.notes: DeprecatedStore comments state hashes cannot be changed and old items must keep hashed IDs for backend scanning.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Old EEPROM conversion chain covers v4, v6, v7, v9, v10, v11, v12, v32787, v32789, v22, and current.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust migration fixtures must preserve the same old EEPROM version chain before current schema loading.
config_contracts.notes: The conversion path advances old records to EEPROM_VERSION 23 before config-store migration into journal entries.

config_contracts.reference_surface: init_config_store reads old EEPROM, checks CRC, converts older versions, erases journal storage, and migrates old values into one backend transaction.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust storage migration path must model old EEPROM detection, CRC gating, conversion, backend erase, and one-transaction migration identity.
config_contracts.notes: Migration records key identities and source paths only; no raw EEPROM bytes are represented.

config_contracts.reference_surface: perform_config_migrations runs versioned config migrations and Backend migration functions read deprecated IDs from current and intermediary banks.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust runtime migration contract must preserve ordered version gates and deprecated-item migration semantics.
config_contracts.notes: Current migrations cover versions 1 through 5 and backend-generated intermediary transactions.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Credential-bearing key names: WIFI AP SSID, WIFI AP Password, PrusaLink Password, Connect Token, Connect Host, Connect Proxy Host, Connect custom TLS certificate.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust credential storage contract must expose these key identities with redacted value handling.
config_contracts.notes: This row intentionally names keys only and excludes password, token, certificate, and host values.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Settings import/export behavior uses /usb/prusa_printer_settings.ini for network, Wi-Fi, and Connect config keys.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust settings import/export contract must preserve source-backed INI sections and mapping to config-store key names.
config_contracts.notes: doc/prusa_printer_settings.ini exists and is cited for key names only; sample values are intentionally not reproduced.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Selftest Result, selftest_result, calibration, and selftest state are stored through ItemFlag::calibrations, SelftestResult structures, and selftest_result migration rows.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust selftest/calibration storage contract must preserve SelftestResult identity, selftest_result field behavior, and calibration flags.
config_contracts.notes: Rows include Run Selftest, Selftest Result lineage, Test Result Phase Stepping, Input Shaper Calibration, and other calibration-backed config items.

config_contracts.reference_surface: journal::hash resolves generated hashes calculated as SHA-256 high bytes masked with 0x3FFF and protected by duplicate detection.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust journal/hash contract must preserve the 0x3FFF mask, generated lookup surface, and duplicate detection evidence.
config_contracts.notes: The generator raises on duplicate IDs and store_definition.cpp asserts unique items against backend reserved IDs.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Journal backend validates transaction CRCs, chooses the newest valid bank, migrates corrupted or compacted banks, and preserves cold-start/migrated states.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust journal backend contract must preserve CRC validation, bank selection, bank migration, and cold-start versus migrated state classification.
config_contracts.notes: Bank-selection behavior is source-audit only; no local flash-wear or power-loss proof is claimed.

config_contracts.reference_surface: Generated visit_all_struct_fields reflection walks aggregate fields for uniqueness checks, dumps, loads, and config-store item iteration.
config_contracts.rust_surface: Rust reflection or catalog contract must preserve field coverage for current and deprecated config items.
config_contracts.notes: The generated header is tracked source output and is linked to its generator for drift review.
